description: Basic Info tab renders business name, primary contact, and Save action on /profile
preconditions: Seller is logged in (any existing seller account) and lands on /profile
checkpoints: Navigate to /profile
Click Basic Info tab
Verify Basic Info tab is active
Verify business / brand name input is present
Verify primary contact (POC) input is present
Verify Save / Save and Next button is present
Confirm no error toasts on the page
expected_result: Basic Info tab loads with all expected fields and Save button visible
